summary.en: Nagoya city housing is open to people who meet the requirements. Household income is in principle 158,000 yen a month or less (conditions can differ by type of recruitment). You must live or work in Nagoya, have a relative living with you, and own no home. Foreign residents are eligible. A single person can apply only in limited cases, such as being 60 or older, holding a disability certificate (with a degree condition), receiving public assistance or being a DV victim (some recruitments are exceptions). Being a student is not itself a condition. There are four kinds of recruitment: general, first-come, fixed-term and welfare. Eligibility is decided after you submit all documents. Confirm at the counter (to be checked).

text.en: Total income of all residents must be 158,000 yen a month or less (in principle). Conditions can differ by type of recruitment. If you plan to retire or quit, there are exceptions and conditions (check the city page; to be checked).

text.en: The applicant's home or workplace must be in Nagoya. You are not eligible if your address cannot be confirmed from the resident record on the reference date. Check the reference date in the recruitment guide (to be checked).
